title: Interview with Eleanor Houghton McLemore, wife of Price C. McLemore of Montgomery, Alabama.
descri: The interview was conducted by Mrs. Phillip Sellers on behalf of the National Society of Colonial Dames of America in Alabama. In it, McLemore discusses the history of the Montgomery Museum of Fine Arts and artist John Kelly Fitzpatrick, who was instrumental in the museum's founding. (The interview's introduction is incomplete and the tape ends mid-sentence; there is no side B on the tape.)
